title: Concept: SecureRandom constructed with a fixed seed in java — review required
description: In java, SecureRandom is constructed with a seed. Reproducibility is exactly what a security token must not have, and the API happily accepts the seed without warning. The pattern usually appears when a developer replaces Random with SecureRandom but keeps the seeding line.
applicability: java services that mint tokens or keys.
risk: Reproducible tokens and keys; MEDIUM severity.
